title: New agreement or Edit agreement
purpose: Record an agreement's terms as a draft, or change what may still change.

items.label: Institution
items.description: Required: the recipient organization. Requests linked to the agreement must be from it; fixed once requests are linked.

items.label: Investigator
items.description: Optional; must belong to the institution.

items.label: Data level
items.description: As the agreement states. Participant codes can go on a manifest only under Coded or Limited data set.

items.label: At the end of use, Onward transfer
items.description: As the agreement states; shown with distributed material.

items.label: Permitted use
items.description: Optional, in the agreement's words. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Permitted scope categories
items.description: Optional. When any are chosen, a request whose uses fall outside them cannot be dispatched under the agreement. Only categories that govern use are offered.

items.label: Expires on
items.description: Optional; not before the effective date.

items.label: Reporting due on
items.description: Optional; shown on the dashboard, never enforced.

items.label: Where the signed agreement is filed
items.description: Optional. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only; required and kept in the timeline. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: States
paragraphs: A draft can be edited freely. Once executed only the title, references, expiry, reporting date and filing reference change; the other fields are shown read-only with that reason, and an amendment is added as a document. A terminated agreement cannot be edited.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

After saving you are taken to the agreement. If someone else changed the record since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; the form keeps your entries and the next save uses the current version, so check the current values first.
Record the terms as stated; the software does not draft, check or interpret agreements.
